title: Safe Deposit Locker - eligibility and availability
text: Safe Deposit Locker facility is subject to availability at the selected branch and the Bank's applicable eligibility.

title: Safe Deposit Locker - allotment subject to availability and policy
text: Locker allotment is subject to availability and the Bank's applicable policy.

title: Safe Deposit Locker - execution of agreement
text: The locker hirer shall execute the Bank's Safe Deposit Locker Agreement in the prescribed format.

title: Safe Deposit Locker - copy of executed agreement provided to hirer
text: A copy of the duly executed locker agreement shall be provided to the locker hirer.

title: Locker Rent - payable as per Bank's Schedule of Charges
text: Locker rent shall be payable as per the Bank's prevailing Schedule of Charges.

title: Locker charges - applicable taxes including GST
text: Applicable taxes, including GST, shall be payable in addition to the applicable charges.

title: Locker Rent - Bank may collect in advance
text: The Bank may collect locker rent in advance in accordance with its policy.

title: Locker charges - additional visits, overdue rent, lost key, break-open
text: The Bank may recover applicable charges for additional visits, overdue rent, lost key, locker break-open, lock replacement and other services, wherever applicable.

title: Locker - access restriction on non-payment of rent
text: In case of non-payment of locker rent, access to the locker may be restricted in accordance with the Bank's policy and applicable regulatory requirements.

title: Safe Deposit Locker - no insurance offered by Bank
text: The Bank shall not offer or arrange insurance for the contents of the locker, directly or indirectly, as part of the locker facility.

title: Locker operation - by hirer and authorized persons
text: The locker shall be operated only by the locker hirer(s) and/or duly authorised person(s), in accordance with the operating instructions registered with the Bank.

title: Locker operation - Bank verification of identity and authority
text: The Bank shall carry out appropriate verification of identity and authority before permitting locker operation.

title: Locker operation - during permitted operating hours
text: The locker shall be operated during the Bank's permitted locker operating hours and subject to the applicable branch procedures.

title: Locker operation - hirer responsibility to secure locker
text: The locker hirer shall ensure that the locker is properly closed and secured after every operation.

title: Locker operation - immediate notification of discrepancies or irregularities
text: The locker hirer shall immediately notify the Bank if any discrepancy, damage, unauthorised access or other irregularity is noticed.

title: Prohibited articles - no illegal or hazardous substances
text: The locker hirer shall not keep any illegal or hazardous substance in the locker.

title: Prohibited articles - no prohibited articles or risk to Bank
text: The locker shall not be used for storing any article or substance that is prohibited under applicable law or may pose a risk to the Bank, its employees, customers, premises or property.

title: Prohibited articles - Bank action on suspected illegal substance
text: If the Bank suspects that any illegal or hazardous substance has been kept in the locker, the Bank may take appropriate action in accordance with applicable law, regulatory requirements and the terms of the locker agreement.

title: Locker key and access credentials - operation mechanism
text: The locker shall be operated using the key/access credentials provided by the Bank and/or through the prescribed authentication mechanism.

title: Locker key and access credentials - safekeeping and non-disclosure
text: The locker hirer shall keep the locker key/access credentials safely and shall not disclose or hand them over to any unauthorised person.

title: Locker key and access credentials - immediate notification of loss
text: In case of loss of the locker key or compromise/loss of access credentials, the locker hirer shall immediately inform the Bank.

title: Locker key replacement - expenses borne by hirer
text: Expenses relating to replacement of lock/key, break-open or restoration of access, wherever applicable, shall be borne by the locker hirer as per the Bank's applicable charges.

title: Nomination - hirer may make nomination
text: The locker hirer may make a nomination in accordance with applicable law and the Bank's prescribed procedure.

title: Nomination - registration, cancellation or variation
text: The nomination may be registered, cancelled or varied in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

title: Nomination - access on death of hirer
text: In the event of death of the locker hirer, access to and release of locker contents shall be governed by the applicable nomination, survivorship mandate, legal requirements and the Bank's prescribed procedure.

title: Death of locker hirer - nominee/survivor/legal heir approach
text: In the event of death of a locker hirer, the nominee(s)/survivor(s)/legal heir(s), as applicable, may approach the Bank for access to the locker contents by submitting the prescribed documents.

title: Death of locker hirer - Bank verification of identity and entitlement
text: The Bank shall verify the identity, death and entitlement of the claimant(s) in accordance with applicable law and its prescribed procedure.

title: Death of locker hirer - release of contents after inventory
text: Where applicable, the contents of the locker shall be accessed and released after following the prescribed inventory and documentation process.

title: Locker surrender - hirer may surrender by prescribed procedure
text: The locker hirer may surrender the locker by following the Bank's prescribed procedure.

title: Locker surrender - removal of contents and return of key
text: On surrender, the locker hirer shall remove all contents and return the locker key/access credentials, wherever applicable.

title: Locker closure - recovery of applicable dues and charges
text: Applicable dues and charges shall be recovered before closure.

title: Locker closure - refund of advance rent
text: Any eligible refund of advance rent shall be processed in accordance with the Bank's applicable policy.

title: Locker closure - lock change and security procedures
text: The Bank may change the lock of a surrendered/vacated locker and follow applicable security procedures before re-allotment.

title: Lost key - immediate notification to Bank
text: In case the locker key is lost, the locker hirer shall immediately notify the Bank.

title: Locker break-open - approved procedure and regulatory compliance
text: The locker may be broken open in accordance with the Bank's approved procedure and applicable regulatory/legal requirements.

title: Locker break-open - due to loss of key
text: Break-open may be undertaken where the locker hirer requests break-open due to loss of key.

title: Locker break-open - authority/law enforcement agency requirement
text: Break-open may be undertaken where a competent authority/law enforcement agency requires access in accordance with law.

title: Locker break-open - non-compliance with agreement
text: Break-open may be undertaken where the Bank is required to take back the locker due to non-compliance with the terms of the locker agreement or other applicable circumstances.

title: Locker break-open - unpaid rent for 3 years
text: Break-open may be undertaken where the locker rent is not paid till 3 years.

title: Locker break-open - costs borne by hirer
text: Costs associated with break-open, lock replacement and other related expenses shall be borne by the locker hirer, wherever applicable.

title: Non-payment of locker rent - Bank notices and further action
text: In case of non-payment of locker rent, the Bank may issue notices and take further action in accordance with the locker agreement, the Bank's approved policy and applicable regulatory requirements.

title: Non-payment of locker rent - break-open and dealing with contents
text: Where the locker rent remains unpaid, the Bank may, after following the prescribed notice and due-process requirements, break open the locker and deal with the contents in accordance with applicable law and regulatory requirements.

title: Non-payment of locker rent - Bank recovery of costs
text: Any costs incurred by the Bank in connection with such action may be recovered from the locker hirer/security available with the Bank, as permissible under the applicable terms and regulations.

title: Bank liability - due care and reasonable diligence
text: The Bank shall exercise due care and reasonable diligence in maintaining and operating the locker facility.

title: Bank liability - negligence cases
text: The Bank shall have liability in accordance with applicable law and RBI directions in cases where loss of locker contents is attributable to the Bank's negligence.

title: Bank liability - limitation on losses from fire, theft, robbery, fraud
text: In cases of loss of locker contents due to incidents such as fire, theft, burglary, robbery, dacoity or building collapse attributable to the Bank's shortcomings, negligence or acts/omissions, or where such loss is attributable to fraud committed by Bank employee(s), the Bank's liability shall be limited to an amount equivalent to one hundred times the prevailing annual locker rent, as prescribed by RBI.

title: Bank liability - events beyond Bank's control
text: The Bank shall not be liable for loss of locker contents arising solely from events beyond the Bank's control, subject to applicable law and the Bank's negligence, if any.
